RESOLVED: Dear Dana Whitfield,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the denial of your MRI claim (CLM-550193). 

"Prior authorization not on file" means that the specific procedure required approval from Meridian Health Plan before it was performed. To resolve this, you have the right to file a first-level appeal. You have 180 days from the date of your denial notice to submit this appeal.

Additionally, your doctor can submit a "retrospective authorization request" along with the clinical documentation supporting the medical necessity of the MRI for your migraines. This is often the fastest way to resolve a denial of this nature.

I have attached the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) to this message. Once you or your provider submit the necessary documentation, standard appeals are typically processed within 30 calendar days. Please let us know if you need further assistance.
